_README: How to add configurations: Create a separate file named '{Customer Name}.json' in this folder (e.g., 'Artech House.json'). Define the configuration per stage. Allowed placeholders in string values: {chapter_name}, {chapter_title}, {current_stage}, {next_stage}, {project_code}, {author_email}, {client_email}, {languageediting_team_email}, {pre_editing_team_email}, {next_stage_team_email}.

Job Initiation.custom_message: The {current_stage} stage has been completed. The chapter has been moved to the {next_stage} stage.
Job Initiation.subject: [{client_name}] {project_code} - Chapter {chapter_name} | {current_stage} → {next_stage} | Stage Transition Notification
Job Initiation.body:
Hi Team,

The {current_stage} stage has been completed for Chapter {chapter_name}.

The chapter has been moved to the {next_stage} stage and is now ready for processing.

Regards,
{current_stage} Team

Note : This is an automated mail and please do not reply.
